frontmatter.name: deep-mongodb-mql-query-optimizer
frontmatter.description: Multi-pass review-and-fix optimizer for one MongoDB MQL find() filter, write-op filter or aggregation pipeline (deep-optimizer loop). TRIGGER: "optimize this MQL/aggregation", "run dmqo", "why is this query slow", "what index for this query", COLLSCAN, blocking sort, slow $lookup, deep skip paging, docsExamined>>nReturned, scatter-gather, plan-cache flapping, slow count/distinct, time-series query slow, slow-log line. Audits ESR/ERS index design, selectivity, shard targeting, operator anti-patterns, $in/$or bounds, stage order, accumulator memory, covered queries, cursor economics and explain (incl. 8.0 query settings, 8.3 cost-based ranker); applies every High/Medium rewrite; verifies via explain when MongoDB MCP is connected. Indexes recommend-only. SKIP: theory -> mongodb-expert; live cluster triage -> atlas-diagnostics-expert; schema redesign -> mongodb:mongodb-schema-design; ODM fixes -> mongodb-odm-patterns; SQL -> deep-query-optimizer; Search relevance -> mongodb-atlas-expert.

changelog: 2026-10-19 v1.3.0->v1.4.0 — folded in the 2026-10-18 MQL full-suite research (8 gated mongodb-expert/atlas-diagnostics-expert spokes, 45 concepts): ERS exception, $in 201-element threshold and SORT_MERGE, rooted-$or blocking-sort risk, same-field $or->$in, $where deprecation, covered-query disqualifiers, partial/sparse eligibility, count/distinct/$sample shapes, batchSize/maxTimeMS semantics, sharded skip/limit and split-pipeline merge, time-series bucket rules (6.3 default index, metaField cardinality, unpack pushdown, 8.0 block processing, last-point DISTINCT_SCAN), 8.0 setQuerySettings vs hint vs index filters, queryShapeHash/planCacheShapeHash, $queryStats, 8.3 cost-based ranker explain fields, spill statistics, slow-log field reading, batch-of-queries edge case; installed top-level (fixes the /dmqo wrapper); description compressed 1430->~1000 chars

2026-09-14 workload-informed audit v1.2.0->v1.3.0 — grounded in ExampleCorp accounts log analysis (v0.4, 2026-09-11) + 31-case /dmqo case corpus; added: degenerate $gte=$lte ranges, $or per-branch index rule, sparse-field $exists / positive-state-model guidance, $elemMatch attribute-pattern checks, string-typed numeric comparison guard, $group accumulator hygiene ($firstN/$topN, sort-before-group, DISTINCT_SCAN), $search-adjacent stage shape, change-stream & cursor/batchSize economics, shard-targeting promoted to P2/P3 audit check, index-consolidation & plan-cache-stability rules, multi-cardinality verification, $indexStats/hidden-index retirement protocol; deferral row for code-deep-optimizer (closes eng-ref L12); bundle now ships convergence_check.py (closes L11); eval set re-pinned + 6 new rows

2026-07-20 sko v1.1.0->v1.2.0 — Pass H 10/10 pos, 0/10 neg (predicted); 1 High + 21 Medium fixed across 3 iters; Blocking-apply contradiction, sharding/write-ops/hint/$expr/regex-i coverage, desc rewrite; edge: code-deep-optimizer
2026-07-17 sko v1.0->v1.1.0 — Pass H 10/10 pos, 9/10->10/10 neg (predicted); 1 High + 15 Medium fixed; edges: collation/clustered/odm/gridfs/time-series/docset-lookup
